mechanism: phase-correlation multi-frame tracklet template on N1-valid occupied conflicts

identity_join.tracklet_source: the frozen APNCC input graph only
identity_join.predecessor_walk: follow at most two unique incoming APNCC edges from the candidate source; stop on missing, nonunique, or nonconsecutive time
identity_join.successor_walk: follow at most two unique outgoing APNCC edges from the candidate destination; stop on missing, nonunique, division, or nonconsecutive time
identity_join.temporal_window: up to three source-side frames ending at t and three destination-side frames beginning at t+1
identity_join.held_labels: forbidden from the join, crop, template, feature, and threshold

image_contract.per_video_intensity: clip read-only raw voxels to fit-video q0.01/q0.99 and map to [0,1]
image_contract.template: voxelwise median over the available, coordinate-centered crops in each side's frozen tracklet window
image_contract.apodization: separable periodic Hann window in Z, Y, and X
image_contract.phase_correlation: float64 FFT cross-power spectrum normalized by max(abs(product), 1e-12), inverse FFT, deterministic lexicographic tie-break on equal peaks
image_contract.subvoxel_refinement: three-point parabolic interpolation independently per axis, clipped to [-0.5,0.5] voxel

action_scope.allowed: only complete N1-valid occupied-conflict swap actions already in the frozen P0-positive swap class
forbidden: raw phase peak as a graph-cost knob
action_scope.missing_template: fall back exactly to centered pair APNCC

controls.beta: centered pair APNCC feature under the identical action population
controls.phase_disabled: template features zeroed with population and head unchanged

literature.citation: Guizar-Sicairos, Thurman, and Fienup, Optics Letters 2008
literature.transfer: subpixel registration, not biological identity or G-02 graph gain
